claim: across the 316 committed mixed-boolean-arithmetic cases, every answer disrobe returns agrees with the held-out original, and a case whose simplification exceeds a 2 second per-entry budget is named as a refusal rather than counted either way. A reference run answered 247 cases, refused 69, and an external bitvector solver proved 236 of the answers equal to the original while refuting none.
detail: 316 entries, each an obfuscated expression whose original is held in a separate file the recovery path never opens: 216 from a forward rewriter written from the published identity tables, at widths 2 through 64 over 1 to 8 variables, and 100 from MBA-Obfuscator run over kernels this repository chose. The count is the population, not a recovery rate. Measured alongside it on this box: 254 of the 316 entries returned an answer inside a 2 second per-entry budget and 0 of those answers disagreed with the held-out original; the other 62 refused the budget and are reported as refusals rather than counted either way. A seeded-wrong recovery that returns one more than the truth is rejected on all 254, and one that swaps addition for exclusive-or is rejected on 252, the 2 survivors being cases where the substitution happens to preserve the value.
gate_source: evidence/corpus/mba/cases.jsonl, regenerated byte-identically by the corpus generator's generate command and gated by cargo test -p disrobe-mba --test evidence_corpus_gate
measured: 316 corpus entries with a held-out original

oracle.external: The originals are held out of the input the pass receives. MBA-Obfuscator (ICICS 2021, MIT, pinned at commit 8574ef8) produced 100 of the 316 cases from integer kernels selected by this repository; their obfuscated form is third-party and the original is the pre-transform kernel. The other 216 cases come from a forward rewriter under evidence/generators/mba that links no disrobe crate, as the workspace health check verifies over the resolved dependency graph. Grading combines a behavioural differential against check vectors computed by the generator's own evaluator with z3 or bitwuzla proofs that the recovered expression equals the held-out original over every input.
oracle.note: The tier is coverage-self-reported because the published number is a population count, not a correctness rate. Seeded wrong recoveries provide controls: returning one more than the truth is rejected on every graded entry, while replacing addition with exclusive-or is rejected except where that substitution preserves the value. Before proving recovered expressions, the solver leg confirms that it can refute a non-equivalent pair. Budget refusals are concentrated in 64-bit polynomial and non-polynomial output from the external obfuscator and in multiplication kernels. They measure the current simplifier's ceiling under the 2 second per-entry budget and are reported by name. The graded count varies slightly with machine load, so the gate enforces a floor rather than an exact figure. A second lane uses published datasets that ship their originals (MBA-Blast, MBA-Solver, Loki). It is fetched at a pinned sha256 rather than committed because none carries a licence this repository may redistribute; it graded 1470 of 1572 entries with 0 disagreements locally and is reported as a local figure, not a continuous-integration figure.

title: Mixed-boolean-arithmetic recovery graded against originals the recovery path never reads
